title: Unknown and unforeseen IEs in the non-imperative message part

entities.name: Non-imperative message part
entities.description: The portion of a message containing information elements that are not critical for message processing and can be ignored if unknown.

entities.name: Unknown information element
entities.description: An information element that is not recognized by the receiver in the non-imperative part of a message.

entities.name: Unforeseen information element
entities.description: An information element that was not anticipated by the receiver's protocol version in the non-imperative part of a message.

entities.name: IE ignorance procedure
entities.description: The procedure where the receiver ignores unknown or unforeseen information elements in the non-imperative part of a message without affecting message processing.

relations.description: The IE ignorance procedure is defined for handling elements in the non-imperative message part.
The procedure establishes that unknown IEs in the non-imperative part are ignored.
The procedure establishes that unforeseen IEs in the non-imperative part are ignored.
